# Project map index

<!-- Generated by `swarmup map index`; do not edit. Run it again after you change a node. -->

- `index` — root — SwarmUp engine monorepo; tasks as Markdown files in git, the swarmup CLI, swarmupd and the desktop app
- `bench` — flow — swarmup bench and the Benchmarks view: replay set entries in throwaway worktrees, score criteria, compare runs
- `cli` — entry — The swarmup command: one COMMANDS table of subcommands over core and swarmupd, used by agents and people
- `core` — area — @swarmup/core: the task store library every other package uses; sync file I/O, no daemon state
- `core/adopt` — module — swarmup adopt, new-project and init; repo survey, project templates and the role templates they copy
- `core/content` — flow — Content projects (W8); campaign and content templates, review artifacts, publish records and the artifact route
- `core/defs` — module — Definitions as code: swarm.yaml, agent folders, workflows; validate, hash, migrate, merge, run stamps
- `core/experiments` — module — Definitions as code, phase 5: experiments that give task runs a variant, runs at a git ref, rubric scorers
- `core/fold` — flow — Folds a task's events in ULID order into its state; the state machine, leases, milestones, plans and criteria
- `core/knowledge` — module — Learn notes (kb/), their reads, prompt matching, promotion and archive, and the decision log (decisions/)
- `core/map` — module — The project map: parse .swarmup/map/ nodes, check coverage of a change, search, _INDEX.md and prompt block
- `core/repeats` — module — Repeating tasks; templates in repeats/ that create a task on a schedule or when another task closes
- `core/search` — module — Search over tasks, threads, notes, posts and votes; the activity feed and the replay timeline
- `core/store` — data — Data root layout on disk; config, ids, ULIDs, event model, frontmatter, roles, channels and attachments
- `core/sync` — flow — swarmup sync: commits, pulls and pushes a data root by policy; git step generators and the Master Repo mirror
- `core/triggers` — module — Definitions as code, phase 4: git triggers with a cron parser; checks behind trust; scorers
- `core/workspace` — module — The Workspace facade; every command (new, claim, review, verdict, ask, inbox, next) goes through it
- `desktop` — area — The Electron app: main process, tray and service control, updates, Add project, installer build
- `desktop/replay` — component — Replay; animated scenes of a root's timeline, with GIF, MP4 and still exports
- `desktop/ui` — component — The React renderer (Vite, Tailwind); views, shared UI pieces and lib helpers over swarmupd's API
- `docs` — area — User and contributor docs, the agent skill copies, and the README media and promo pipeline
- `improve` — flow — Self-improvement: improvement tasks from failing scores and learn notes, the improver, proposals, the benchmark gate
- `judge` — flow — The LLM judge of rubric criteria: rubric files, the blind no-tools prompt, the JSON answer, and where it runs
- `leaks` — module — Secret scanning; one pattern set for the event write path, the leak check script and the pre-commit hook
- `release` — flow — Cutting a release; version bump, changelog fragments, UPDATES entry, tag and the release workflow
- `supervisor` — service — swarmupd: the per-machine service; tick loop, config, state folder, HTTP API, doctor and notifications
- `supervisor/chat` — service — The desktop Chat with the PM; each message is a read-only Claude run that resumes one session
- `supervisor/hooks` — flow — Inbound webhook triggers (W8 phase 4); the listener, verifiers, dedupe, fenced findings, swarmup trigger fire|test
- `supervisor/mcp` — flow — MCP servers on roles (W8); server config, secrets.yml, the run grant, the mcp exec proxy and resolve route
- `supervisor/merge` — flow — Merges approved work into the base; rebase, path-scoped checks, batches, fast-forward, build and branch pushes
- `supervisor/prompts` — module — Runtime invocations and run prompts; work, review, question and check prompts, run context, resumes, tools, deny lists
- `supervisor/runs` — module — A run's process, records, environment, task worktrees, leftovers commits and process ledger
- `supervisor/stats` — module — swarmup report, scores and wrapped; throughput, loop figures, run costs, scorers and the Wrapped card sequence
- `supervisor/wake` — flow — Wake planning, launch and limits; which agent runs which task where, usage pauses, sign-in and stuck runs
- `tooling` — area — Workspace build, lint, format, typecheck, tests and CI configuration, plus dev scripts
